chunk_grid.index: i = column from west, j = row from north

height.nodata: filled from the nearest valid pixel (count per chunk: filled_px)

texture: WS1 HiRISE LRGB ortho (colour, greyscale where the mosaic is greyscale), JPEG per near chunk; no-ortho texels = horizon.yaml panorama.ground_rgb

skyline_check.azimuth_convention: deg clockwise from grid north (analysis CRS); index k = k * step
skyline_check.curvature: drop = d^2 / (2 R), R = config/site.yaml crs.mars_radius_m
skyline_check.pass_rule_note: pass_rule true = in the F20 pass rule (pad and route stations, C 12:35); false = reported only (excluded_reason)

pad.source: WS2 data/interim/engine/public/pad.json top-level pad (D21 official pad)
pad.pad_source: D21 (user 2026-11-14 16:14): the candidate pad with the most feasible EVAs (nominal 104 kg; tiebreaks: reachable % of the assessed flat 30-min disc, then lower elevation); pipeline/engine/padpick.py

station_rings.note: per station: WS3 horizon points beyond the far-mesh square at their true position (z = z_eye + d tan(el) + d^2/2R, R = config/site.yaml crs.mars_radius_m); null = inside the square (drawn by the mesh) or unknown. Drawn as extra far-skyline curtains next to WS3's pad ring
